items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Stan Strickland was present when Joe Henderson was at NYU, but the interviewee (Frank Foster) does not mention knowing, meeting, or working with Stan Strickland.

ctx.x: That’s when Joe was -- he came around -- it had to be ’67 when Kenny McIntyre was there. Some other cats. Stan Strickland, who was a tenor player from Boston [Originally from Springfield, Ohio], was there then, and Sidney Smart, a drummer out of Cleveland was there, but anyway.

Now at NYU I’m there five times a semester. I have a -- I rehearse the jazz ensemble. I hope to recruit some more black students for that jazz ensemble. I’m one of the first African-Americans on the jazz faculty. Maybe we’ll pull some more of us in there soon.
